judgment.H194b: condition-level share is negligible (1.43% < 10%) -> Q is dominated by condition x cell-pair interaction (48.5%) and barcode measurement noise (46.1%); condition structure is mainly cell-specific
judgment.A2_is_not: an A1 pass, a cross-screen Q replication, or a rescue by re-aggregating the same 96 cells
judgment.branch_per_BRIEF: condition_structure_present -> any future condition-level replica would need a LARGER independent resource (and better noise calibration); B/C/acquisition not started

tokens.note: runtime token accounting is not available to the agent; recorded as null (not 0)

notes: design check ran before any H194a/H194b judgment; all 15 gates passed (power at sigma_cond/sigma_total=0.4 is 1.00, type-I 0.00)

verdict: condition_structure_present by the frozen H194a rule (sigma2_cond>0, CI lower>0, above permutation null, reliability>=0.50) BUT the frozen H194b diagnostic classifies the condition-level share as negligible (1.43% < 10%)
Q variance is dominated by condition x cell-pair interaction (48.5%) and barcode measurement noise (46.1%); cell-pair main effect 3.9%
high reliability (0.868) is a consequence of averaging over ~435 cell pairs per condition pair, not of a large condition-level variance share - both must be cited together

noise calibration covers only 1.43% of observations (barcode repeats); stability ratios pass but stationarity is the main measurement-regime uncertainty; sigma2_cond itself does not depend on the noise calibration
Validation is exploratory only (condition-level Spearman 0.177, CI [0.055,0.296]); it is NOT a cross-screen Q replication
